site.full_name: Organismal Research in Genomics, Integrative Systematics and Natural History
site.tagline: Tracing biodiversity from landscape to lineage.
site.description: ORiGIN Lab investigates how species arise, diversify and persist using field biology, morphology, molecular data, museum collections and evolutionary analysis.
site.institution: Department of Zoology, Bharata Mata College (Autonomous)

principal_investigator.name: Dr. Jithin Johnson, FLS
principal_investigator.title: Assistant Professor
principal_investigator.affiliation: Department of Zoology, Bharata Mata College (Autonomous)
principal_investigator.bio: Jithin is an evolutionary biologist and arachnologist working on pseudoscorpion systematics, Western Ghats biogeography, phylogenomics, integrative taxonomy, fossil arachnids and invertebrate conservation.
roles: Visiting Scientist, Museum of Nature Hamburg (LIB)
Fellow of the Linnean Society of London

research_themes.title: Systematics & Species Discovery
research_themes.description: Comparative morphology, diagnostic characters, taxonomic revision and integrative species delimitation.

research_themes.title: Phylogenetics & Phylogenomics
research_themes.description: Evolutionary relationships inferred using multilocus and genome-scale data, with explicit attention to uncertainty and concordance.

research_themes.title: Historical Biogeography
research_themes.description: Testing how vicariance, dispersal, climate and geological history shaped present-day organismal distributions.

research_themes.title: Collections, Fossils & Imaging
research_themes.kicker: Evidence from specimens and deep time
research_themes.description: Connecting modern biodiversity with museum specimens, fossil inclusions, microscopy and non-destructive imaging.

research_questions: How does geography structure evolutionary diversity?
How can overlooked species be recognised?
What can low-dispersal arthropods reveal about deep time?
How can genomic, morphological and geographic evidence be integrated?
How can taxonomy contribute to biodiversity conservation?

workflow.title: Morphology & imaging
workflow.text: Microscopy, diagnostic structures and comparative characters.

workflow.title: Molecular data
workflow.text: DNA barcodes, multilocus datasets and genomic evidence.

workflow.title: Evolutionary analysis
workflow.text: Phylogeny, dating, concordance and biogeographic inference.

workflow.title: Open outputs
workflow.text: Publications, datasets, collections and conservation evidence.

projects.title: Integrative Revision of Western Ghats Tyrannochthoniini
projects.summary: An integrative taxonomic and biogeographic revision combining morphology, molecular evidence and evolutionary analyses to resolve poorly known Western Ghats pseudoscorpion diversity.

projects.title: Multi-lineage UCE Phylogenomics in the Western Ghats
projects.summary: A comparative framework designed to test whether different low-dispersal pseudoscorpion lineages preserve concordant geographic and evolutionary signals.

projects.title: Comparative Tyrannochthonius Systematics
projects.summary: Comparative study of North American and East Asian lineages using museum collections, morphology, molecular evidence and phylogenomic approaches.

projects.title: Western Ghats Tarantula Conservation
projects.summary: Field-based research supporting distributional baselines, habitat documentation and conservation assessment for threatened and poorly known Western Ghats tarantulas.
